responsibility: Declares the FIXED_VALUE_TYPE representation for GCC fixed-point constants and the public API for constructing, converting, hashing, comparing, printing, and performing arithmetic on them. It ties fixed-point payloads to scalar machine modes, exposes the cached fixed-point zero/one tables and CONST_FIXED builders, and serves as the interface between tree/RTL constant nodes and the fixed-point conversion routines implemented in fixed-value.cc.
same_name_distinction: Defines FIXED_VALUE_TYPE, fixed-point constant tables/macros, and the public entry points for building, converting, comparing, and printing fixed-point constants; unlike gcc/fixed-value.cc, it is the declaration/interface file rather than the code that performs those operations.
